# Vendored third-party assets

## chart.umd.min.js

Chart.js **v4.4.9** UMD build, MIT licensed.

Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/chart.js/-/chart.js-4.4.9.tgz` → `package/dist/chart.umd.js`
(the production build; already minified). Served by the dashboard at
`/vendor/chart.umd.min.js` so charts render offline with no CDN dependency
(local-first). To upgrade, download a newer 4.x tarball, replace the file, and
update this version note.
